messages:
maria: Quick sync — vendors asked for a joint benchmark release that includes H100 / H200 / MI300 / Gaudi numbers + cloud marketplace SKU tags. They want publication the week of Apr 7. Draft plan here: https://go/redwood/bench-plan (please don't share externally yet).
aj: I can own vendor handoff. Need the actual VM/GPU images and any vendor firmware notes. @sophia can you confirm marketplace tagging flow and validation windows?
sophia: I can do SKU tagging. Marketplace requires final image IDs, pricing tier, and a 48h validation window before publish. Also need to know if we surface quantization/precision details on the SKU page.
kevin: I'll write a short reproducibility blurb for DevEx and a commands snippet. Draft command: ```bash
rdw-bench run --model h100 --seq 2048 --batch 4
``` — will add more variants for MI300/Gaudi.
maria: @aj can you ping vendor PMs for images + any perf caveats? Vendors mentioned wanting a co-branded visual for the blog. Is that something we can accept?
aj: Pinged NVIDIA & Habana PMs — they shared images but flagged H200 early firmware variability on long sequences. We'll add a note flagging that variance and the image tag that was used. Looping in legal if co-branding is requested.
announce-bot: Reminder: marketplace publish window currently set to 2026-04-09 10:00 UTC unless a blocker is filed.
sophia: Given the 48h validation, final artifacts need to land by 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC. I'll create a tag checklist & quick QA runbook in the sheet.
maria: Action items: @aj vendor images + firmware notes by EOD (1718880000), @kevin devex blurb and commands by EOD (1718883600), @sophia SKU tags + validation guardrails by 1718887200. I'll coordinate co-brand approval with legal. :thumbsup:
